cross_module_impacts.impact: PreprocessorRegions IsDefined builds a std::string key per lookup; making the defined-words set transparent (TransparentStringHash, std::equal_to<>) changes its type across WorkspaceStateStore, Server and ServerModules, so it is deferred to the lsp/ milestone.

Checkers still hold TSNode and call DiagnosticContext::EmitAtNodeRange(ToOptionalSourceRange(node), ...); once they read indexed ranges, delete EmitAtNodeRange and ToOptionalSourceRange (analysis/index/Symbol.h).

TypeExtraction moved to analysis/index; DefiniteAssignmentChecker still passes TSNode to ExtractTypeInfoFromAST/IsNullInitializer. Once they read indexed type facts, drop those calls from the checkers.
